questions.prompt: What does 'So, physical distance clearly matters' do after the numbers?
questions.promptZh: 数字之后 So,physical distance clearly matters 做什么？
options: It denies any relation between residence and social contact.
It proves physical distance is the sole sufficient cause of every friendship.
It starts a new experiment that measures no relationships.
It draws the author's conclusion from the reported pattern of nearby nominations.
optionsZh: 否认住址与交往有任何联系。
证明物理距离是每段友谊唯一充分原因。
开始不测关系的新实验。

analyses: A So 接总结而非否认。
